cloud_evidence_follow_up.purpose: Run provider-backed D1/R2 cloud storage workloads on a production-representative corpus; publish storage latency, metering, dated prices, durability and raw samples. No shard recommendation.

optional_atlas_owner_artifact.contract: #9133 may validate and link an owner-produced search result; verify schema version, eval-set digest, corpus digest and shard-config IDs. Do not rerun recall or recommend shards.
optional_atlas_owner_artifact.missing_or_invalid: omit link; storage report remains valid with no search/shard claim

cloud_evidence_follow_up.acceptance: Storage-only p50/p95/p99, throughput, errors, native bill units, dated prices, durability/RPO, replica semantics and raw samples; no placement winner without comparable repetitions and never a shard recommendation

logical_operations.meaning: write immutable bytes if canonical content ID absent; identical replay preserves row/references; ordinary put against tombstoned generation rejects unless explicit resurrection creates new generation and physical key
logical_operations.d1: transactional blob row + unique tenant/content key; record rows written
logical_operations.r2: conditional PutObject write by opaque generation-qualified locator + verify checksum; never reuse generation key; record Class A and bytes
logical_operations.redb: write transaction insert absent; commit; read back
logical_operations.turso: transaction insert absent; commit; record push/pull state
indexed select from local DB; note sync revision

logical_operations.meaning: tenant + content ID exact metadata lookup
logical_operations.r2: GET manifest sidecar; not transactional index

logical_operations.meaning: same predicate and ordered result set over fixed tenant rows
logical_operations.r2: list/prefix only if semantically equivalent; otherwise unsupported (object listing is not SQL scan)
logical_operations.redb: table range scan with same ordering/filter

logical_operations.meaning: atomically add reference only if authority generation is Live(g)
logical_operations.r2: unsupported alone; requires external transactional authority
logical_operations.redb: single write transaction on authority DB
logical_operations.turso: single DB transaction; cross-replica conflict semantics separately tested

logical_operations.meaning: remove existing logical reference in authoritative ref store
logical_operations.r2: unsupported alone; requires external transactional authority
logical_operations.redb: single write transaction on authority DB
logical_operations.turso: single DB transaction; cross-replica conflict semantics separately tested

logical_operations.meaning: atomically fence generation in authoritative reference store; not a physical delete and does not claim provider conditional-delete support
logical_operations.r2: external authoritative fence required before physical delete

logical_operations.meaning: after authority fence and grace, plain-delete only captured immutable generation-qualified physical key; key is never reused, so stale delete cannot alias resurrection
logical_operations.d1: delete captured generation row only after authority fence
logical_operations.r2: plain DeleteObject on captured never-reused key only after external fence and proven non-reuse; otherwise unsupported/disabled
logical_operations.redb: authority fence then external plain delete of captured never-reused key
logical_operations.turso: authority fence then external plain delete of captured never-reused key

correctness_oracle: benchmark-workload-oracle.py executes finite reference-store and physical-generation-key transitions, computes fixture digest, and compares each transition to synthetic-workload.json; no timing assertion or provider-delete claim
shard_and_recall_scope: Owned entirely by #9092 using #8627. #9133 storage results never recommend shard configurations. Optional #9092 artifact consumption is link/validation only.
